items.title: Document Host Overflow architecture and boundaries
items.context: Add a host-neutral architecture document for Lattice Host Overflow / Host Conduit. It must define Lattice as authority, hosts as executors, manual mode first, supervised dispatch as conservative projection, and explicit non-goals such as no hidden-context sharing or auto-trust.
items.userSees: 用户在 README/docs 中看到明确句子："Lattice Host Overflow is manual-first; Lattice keeps story/scope/receipt authority; Claude Code is an execution host, not a production authority."

happy.desc: Docs explain Lattice Host Overflow as host-neutral authority: Lattice owns story/scope/receipt/gate, Codex/Claude Code/Gemini are execution hosts.

edge.desc: Docs explicitly say manual handoff comes before supervised dispatch and Claude Code unavailable is a diagnostic degradation, not a workflow blocker.

adversarial.desc: Docs do not claim Lattice is a new agent runtime, Mac App requirement, productionDone source, or automatic trust/merge mechanism for Claude Code output.

verificationEvidence.note: README/guide/vision/nav and the new host-overflow decision doc describe the manual-first authority boundary and Claude Code execution-host role.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "manual-first|supervised dispatch|diagnostic degradation|not a workflow blocker" README.md docs/guide.md docs/requirements/decisions/host-overflow.md
verificationEvidence.note: Docs state manual-first handoff precedes supervised dispatch and unavailable Claude Code is reported as diagnostic degradation rather than a local workflow blocker.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "not a new agent runtime|Mac App is not required|productionDone=false|no auto-trust|no auto-merge" README.md docs/guide.md docs/requirements/decisions/host-overflow.md
verificationEvidence.note: Docs state Lattice Host Overflow is not a new runner, does not require Mac App, and does not claim productionDone, auto-trust, or auto-merge authority.

items.title: Add host capability model for overflow readiness
items.context: Implement a CLI-visible capability report for claude-code/codex/local-runner style hosts, including availability, edit/shell/worktree/review/receipt capabilities, limits, and nextAction when unavailable.
items.userSees: 用户运行 lattice host_status --host=claude-code --format=json 看到 "schemaVersion":"lattice.host_status.v1", "overflowReady":true/false, "status":"ready|degraded|unavailable", "nextAction":"..."。

happy.desc: lattice host_status --host=claude-code --format=json reports overflow readiness, capabilities, limits, availability, and nextAction.

edge.desc: Unknown or unavailable host returns diagnostic unavailable/warn with nextAction and does not block local story workflow.

adversarial.desc: Capability/status output keeps productionDone=false and receiptVerified=false; it never treats host availability as authority evidence.

verificationEvidence.note: host-overflow smoke covers lattice host_status for claude-code/local-runner and proves overflowReady/status/nextAction stay diagnostic-only with productionDone=false and receiptVerified=false.
Host Overflow smoke covers unavailable and non-ready host diagnostics with nextAction while keeping the local story workflow unblocked.
Host Overflow smoke asserts host_status output stays diagnostic-only with productionDone=false and receiptVerified=false.

items.title: Create bounded handoff pack schema and CLI
items.context: Add handoff pack creation/inspection for host overflow tasks with storyId, role, host, objective, baseSha, allowedPaths, deniedPaths, requiredCommands, successCriteria, authority boundary, and pack hash.
items.userSees: 用户运行 lattice handoff_create ... --format=json 看到 "packId":"HP-...", "packHash":"sha256:...", "baseSha":"...", "allowedPaths":[...], "requiredCommands":[...], "productionDone":false。

happy.desc: lattice handoff_create can create a Claude Code overflow pack with role, objective, baseSha, packId, packHash, allowedPaths, deniedPaths, requiredCommands, successCriteria, and authority boundary.

edge.desc: Existing handoff_create/inspect/accept/resume compatibility remains intact for old handoff-pack-v0 consumers.

adversarial.desc: Handoff pack instructions forbid direct story JSON edits, auto-merge, auto-trust, evidence submission, receipt verification, and productionDone claims.

verificationEvidence.note: lattice-handoff smoke verifies bounded handoff packs include packId/packHash/baseSha-safe boundaries while preserving legacy handoff-pack-v0 compatibility and non-authoritative projections.
Lattice handoff smoke preserves existing handoff_create, inspect, accept, and resume compatibility for handoff-pack-v0 consumers.

Host Overflow smoke verifies handoff pack instructions preserve authority boundaries and forbid direct story JSON edits, auto-merge, auto-trust, evidence submission, receipt verification, and productionDone claims.

items.title: Add manual receipt submit and gate-consumable evidence
items.context: Implement a receipt submit/read path for completed external host handoffs. Receipt must reference packId/hash/base/head, commands, changedFiles, verdict, limitations, and scope status. session_brief or inspect output should surface active/completed handoff state.
items.userSees: 用户运行 lattice handoff_receipt_submit --file=receipt.json --format=json 看到 "status":"accepted-local", "scopeStatus":"pass|warn|fail", "freshness":"fresh|stale", "receiptVerified":false, "productionDone":false。

happy.desc: lattice handoff_receipt_submit accepts a completed external-host receipt referencing packId/hash/base/head, commands, changedFiles, verdict, and limitations, then returns accepted-local status.

edge.desc: Receipt submit reports stale or scope warning/failure when head/base/hash or changedFiles do not match the pack constraints.

adversarial.desc: Receipt submit remains local diagnostic evidence with authorityChanged=false, receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false, and cannot satisfy server authority by itself.

verificationEvidence.note: host-overflow smoke validates handoff_receipt_submit accepted-local and diagnostic flows, including pack-hash validation, scopeStatus, freshness, and the fixed authorityChanged=false / receiptVerified=false / productionDone=false boundary.
Host Overflow smoke covers stale head and pack hash mismatch plus changedFiles scope warning and failure diagnostics.
Host Overflow smoke asserts handoff_receipt_submit remains accepted-local diagnostic evidence only with authorityChanged=false, receiptVerified=false, and productionDone=false.

items.title: Add overflow worktree isolation guidance
items.context: Provide safe worktree guidance and creation metadata for overflow tasks. Each external-host task should have its own branch/worktree, baseSha, packId, allowedPaths, deniedPaths, and merge/cleanup guidance. Do not include unavailable-host reporting here; host availability belongs to CHK-002.
items.userSees: 用户运行 lattice handoff_worktree_create --file=pack.json --format=json 看到 "worktreePath":".worktrees/overflow/...", "branch":"overflow/...", "baseSha":"...", "packId":"HP-...", "cleanupCommand":"..."。

happy.desc: lattice handoff_worktree_create or equivalent projection returns worktree path, branch, baseSha, packId, allowedPaths, deniedPaths, and cleanup/merge guidance for an overflow task.

edge.desc: Worktree isolation guidance refuses or warns when pack constraints are missing and does not modify external host results.

adversarial.desc: Worktree projection does not auto-merge, does not delete unaccepted work, and keeps external host edits outside the main Codex worktree until reviewed.

verificationEvidence.note: host-overflow smoke proves handoff_worktree_create returns isolated branch/worktree/cleanup guidance only, keeps external work unmerged, and warns when pack constraints are incomplete.
Host Overflow smoke covers incomplete or unsafe pack constraints through warnings and keeps external host results untouched.
Host Overflow smoke asserts worktree projection returns guidance only and does not auto-merge, delete, or trust external host edits.

items.title: Cover Host Overflow with tests and delivery transcript
items.context: Add smoke tests for capability report, handoff pack creation/inspection, receipt submit, stale/hash/scope behavior, and supervised dispatch unavailable behavior. Record a user-facing transcript showing manual Claude Code overflow flow without requiring Mac App.
items.userSees: 用户在 transcript 中看到 "Manual Claude Code overflow flow: pack created -> receipt accepted-local -> scopeStatus=pass -> productionDone=false -> nextAction=main agent reviews and merges."

happy.desc: Host Overflow smoke passes and demonstrates host_status, handoff_create, handoff_receipt_submit, handoff_worktree_create, and host_dispatch JSON contracts.

edge.desc: Smoke covers unavailable host, stale/hash mismatch, and out-of-scope changedFiles without blocking local workflow.

adversarial.desc: Transcript and tests prove the flow works without Mac App and without claiming server receipt or production authority.

verificationEvidence.note: Transcript records the manual Claude Code overflow flow without Mac App and shows pack created -> receipt accepted-local -> scopeStatus=pass -> productionDone=false -> main-agent review/merge nextAction.
Host Overflow smoke covers unavailable/non-ready host behavior, pack hash mismatch, stale receipt freshness, and out-of-scope changedFiles without blocking local workflow.
Host Overflow smoke passed and demonstrates host_status, handoff_create, handoff_receipt_submit, handoff_worktree_create, and host_dispatch JSON contracts.

items.title: Add conservative supervised dispatch projection
items.context: Add a host_dispatch-style projection for overflow tasks. It may detect whether Claude Code is unavailable and return unavailable/warn with nextAction, and when available it records planned dispatch metadata only. It must not auto-trust results, auto-merge diffs, submit authority evidence, or claim productionDone.
items.userSees: 用户运行 lattice host_dispatch --host=claude-code --file=pack.json --mode=supervised --format=json 看到 "status":"planned|unavailable", "nextAction":"...", "authorityChanged":false, "productionDone":false。

happy.desc: lattice host_dispatch --host=claude-code --pack=<pack> --mode=supervised --format=json returns planned dispatch metadata with nextAction and no authority changes.

edge.desc: When Claude Code is unavailable, host_dispatch returns unavailable/warn plus nextAction instead of failing the local workflow.

adversarial.desc: host_dispatch never auto-trusts results, auto-merges diffs, submits evidence, verifies receipts, or claims productionDone.

verificationEvidence.note: host-overflow smoke verifies host_dispatch returns planned or unavailable with nextAction only, while preserving authorityChanged=false, receiptVerified=false, and productionDone=false.
Host Overflow smoke covers unavailable host_dispatch output with warning and nextAction instead of failing the local workflow.
Host Overflow smoke asserts host_dispatch never auto-trusts output, auto-merges diffs, submits evidence, verifies receipts, or claims productionDone.
